narrative_md:
NECSI is currently seeking outstanding research scientists interested in studying networks, agent-based modeling, multiscale analysis and complexity, chaos and predictability, evolution, ecology, biodiversity, altruism, systems biology, cellular response, healthcare and dynamic medicine, systems engineering, negotiation, military conflict, ethnic violence, and international development. For more information and an application, please click [here.](https://necsi.edu/faculty-position)
